project.name: nablatensor-cuda
project.description: Everything CUDA: the java.lang.foreign runtime (NVRTC compile + dispatch, no JNI, no native jar), the tensor ComputeBackend, and the replay engine — a recorded tape code-generated into a fused forward+adjoint CUDA kernel, NVRTC-compiled once, replayed one scenario per thread. Compiles with or without the CUDA toolchain present; gates at runtime.
